visual_review.findings: The shared device dialog makes selected problems and the response scope visible; equal-width actions and inline configuration rows remain readable. The availability confirmation lists exact entity names directly and repeats no policy list. Narrow layouts wrap and scroll; enlarged text keeps labels intact.
visual_review.purpose: Monitoring owns status and coverage; one shared dialog owns issue responses. Selection supports individual exceptions. Stop Monitoring requires review of its own exact availability scope.

corrected_attempts: Initial quick checks found two expectations for superseded per-issue device buttons; corrected to the single device View.

Initial fixture browser lacked loopback access; final runs use the authorized browser test environment. A hidden receipt required textContent, and native dialog Close required waiting for its close event.
The device entry case expected a normalized /issues path, while the actual origin was /homeostatic; it now verifies the captured originating URL and retained context.

Review found combined selection included passive evidence gaps and recovery-only entries hidden by Open issues. The shared model now reuses the existing visibility rules, with focused regression coverage.

Enlarged-text inspection found fixed label widths split words, and the queue disclosure marker had corrupted text. Final candidate uses intrinsic label width, an action pair that stacks when enlarged text needs room, and the correct marker. Earlier candidate reports remain in build/ui-acceptance.
